kept_breakthroughs.plain_title: Optimized CUDA Graph Ladder & Moderate Micro-Batching
kept_breakthroughs.hypothesis: Using a moderate micro-batching limit (seqs=24, tokens=4096) absorbs arrival bursts to prevent host-side queueing without causing mega-batch slowdowns. Combining this with a dense CUDA graph capture ladder up to 2048 tokens bypasses CPU launch overhead. We also lower OMP_NUM_THREADS to 4 to reduce CPU core scheduling contention.
